title: Rules, rights and duties at school
subject: CIVICS

objectives.statement: Name a rule at home or school and say how it keeps people safe, healthy or fair.

moe.note: No MOE Civics document exists; MOE Grade 1 Social Studies 'Apply safety rules at home and at school' is proposed through the Civics → Social Studies proxy, which needs an owner decision.

objectives.statement: Tell a right (something every child should have) from a duty (something we should do), with one school example of each.

moe.note: MOE Grade 1 Social Studies covers family roles, safety and health rules, and respect, but has no rights-and-duties objective. This is a LiberiaLearn objective that needs an owner's scope decision.

successCriteria.independentPerformance: Alone with the teacher, the child shows or names a real home or school rule and says a safety, health or fairness reason, explains why a rule matters when no one is watching, suggests a fair rule for an unfamiliar place (the market), and still names a rule and reason one week later.
Without prompting, the child sorts four picture cards into rights and duties correctly, says one right and one duty aloud, and a week later still calls keeping the classroom clean a duty.

prerequisites: Can listen to a short spoken story and answer who and what questions about it.
Knows familiar places such as home, school and market by name.

layers.nationalFoundation: Safety and health rules at home and school (MOE Grade 1 Social Studies, through the Civics proxy).
layers.liberiaLearnMastery: Rights and duties distinguished by performance, misconception-specific feedback, teacher-recorded oral reasoning and a one-week retrieval.
layers.globalExcellence: Transfer of fairness reasoning to the market, and an optional invent-a-rule drawing.

legacyDisposition.heading: Objective
legacyDisposition.rationale: Generic, unassessable objective replaced by two observable ones.

legacyDisposition.heading: Teacher Explanation
legacyDisposition.rationale: Describes how to teach without teaching; replaced by short read-aloud explanations.

legacyDisposition.heading: Worked Examples or Demonstrations
legacyDisposition.rationale: Placeholder ('Model a short scenario…'); replaced by the ball-and-road scenario.

legacyDisposition.heading: Guided Practice
legacyDisposition.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by right-or-duty items and misconception checks.

legacyDisposition.heading: Independent Practice
legacyDisposition.rationale: Placeholder that asked Grade 1 learners to write; replaced by choices and spoken answers recorded by the teacher.

legacyDisposition.heading: Assessment Questions
legacyDisposition.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by teacher-recorded performance tasks with rubrics.

legacyDisposition.heading: Remediation Support
legacyDisposition.rationale: Generic remediation replaced by prerequisite diagnostics with fallback routes.

legacyDisposition.heading: Extension or Challenge
legacyDisposition.rationale: Replaced by the optional invent-a-rule extension.

legacyDisposition.heading: Guardian Support
legacyDisposition.rationale: Home conversation idea kept for teacher and guardian notes.

legacyDisposition.heading: Real-World Application
legacyDisposition.rationale: The abstract 'connect to community participation' note is replaced by the concrete ball-and-road story.

legacyDisposition.heading: Materials and Activity Notes
legacyDisposition.rationale: Teacher-facing materials note; picture cards added for the performance task.

legacyDisposition.heading: Additional Teacher Notes
legacyDisposition.rationale: A word-for-word duplicate of the previous section.

openDecisions.question: Adopt MOE Social Studies as the authority for Grade 1 Civics lessons?
openDecisions.authorRecommendation: Yes, as a recorded owner decision covering all 133 Civics lessons, not decided lesson by lesson.

openDecisions.question: Accept rights and duties as a LiberiaLearn Grade 1 objective outside the MOE list?
openDecisions.authorRecommendation: Accept as LiberiaLearn mastery, never as an MOE requirement.

openDecisions.question: Four live lessons (foundations, teacher-modeling, guided-application, independent-practice) carry this same learner text and 60 learners' progress each. Which one does this candidate replace?
openDecisions.authorRecommendation: Map all four to this one candidate in the legacy mapping plan (Cleanup Plan V1's survivor), keeping every historical row pinned to the revision learners actually saw.

openDecisions.question: The two IMAGE media are described but have no governed asset.
openDecisions.authorRecommendation: Commission simple line drawings; until then the teacher tells the story without pictures (media is optional).
